violation_type.title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School (26 TAC §744.1107(b))
violation_type.short_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School
violation_type.typical_finding: A high school student under the age of 18 was counted in ratio but is not currently enrolled or completed a child care related care program through the Texas Education Agency. Additionally this person had the sole responsibility for a group of children at one point during inspection.

finding_variants.text: A high school student under the age of 18 was counted in ratio but is not currently enrolled or completed a child care related care program through the Texas Education Agency. Additionally this person had the sole responsibility for a group of children at one point during inspection.

A high school student under the age of 19 was counted in ratio but is not currently enrolled or completed a child care related care program through the Texas Education Agency. Additionally this person was alone with sole responsibility of children.
